title: Senior Backend Engineer (Bengaluru, Karnataka — Fintech / Scale)
description:
Location: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka (Hybrid)
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (3-6 years) for our high-throughput transactional platform. Requirements:
- Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI, Django) or Go, and designing microservices.
- Deep understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and Redis in-memory caching.
- Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, EKS).
- Experience with high-scale event streaming using Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
- B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from an accredited university.
- Good grasp of Data Structures, Algorithms (DSA), System Design, and automated unit testing with Pytest.

title: Data Analyst (Gurugram / NCR — Product & E-Commerce)
description:
Location: Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana / Delhi NCR
Leading consumer internet startup is hiring a Data Analyst (2-4 years experience):
- Strong hands-on SQL proficiency across BigQuery, Snowflake, or PostgreSQL data warehouses.
- Experience designing interactive business dashboards in Tableau and Power BI for leadership.
- Hands-on data wrangling in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scipy) or R, with knowledge of A/B Testing.
- Build and maintain data transformation models using dbt and Apache Airflow.
- B.Tech / BCA / MCA / M.Sc Statistics or related quantitative degree.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Bengaluru / Hyderabad — NLP & Applied AI)
description:
Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad (Tech Corridor)
Join our Applied AI research team working on document intelligence and NLP:
- B.Tech / M.Tech / M.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, or related quantitative discipline.
- Solid experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, and NLP (token classification, embeddings).
- Familiarity with Scikit-Learn, Pandas, NumPy, and model containerization via Docker.
- Understanding of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA), retrieval-augmented pipelines, and model evaluation metrics.

title: Senior Frontend Developer (Pune / Bengaluru — React, Next.js, TypeScript)
description:
Location: Pune / Bengaluru (Remote-friendly)
Product engineering squad hiring a Frontend Developer (2-5 years experience):
- Strong expertise in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React, and Next.js.
- Clean modern UI styling with Tailwind CSS or CSS Modules, emphasizing responsive design.
- Experience with state management (Redux Toolkit) and RESTful / GraphQL API integration.
- Automated unit testing with Jest and Cypress.
- B.Tech / B.E. / MCA or equivalent degree.
